subject: Orion Medical — request for extended tenant debug log retention & SIG/CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Samuel Young <samuel.young@orionmed.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 180d tenant debug log retention + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Hi Karthik —

Quick one from the security and procurement teams here at Orion Medical. Our incident response and clinical audit policies require tenant-level debug traces be retained for 180 days. Redwood's standard retention for debug/session traces is 30 days per the public docs; we need to understand whether a scoped, customer-specific variance is possible for our account (ORN-2028-0893).

Concretely we need:
- Confirmation whether Redwood can retain tenant debug traces (indexes + ephemeral debug snapshots) for 180 days for Orion only (not all tenants).
- A copy or map of CAIQ responses and SIG items that relate to log retention, secure deletion, and access controls.
- Any SOC 2 artifacts or attestation excerpts that reference retention or secure delete practices.

Our timeline is tight — procurement wants evidence to accompany a contract amendment by Nov 5. Can you loop in security/compliance and let us know the required justification and what evidence you can ship?

Thanks,
Samuel Young
Head of IT Security — Orion Medical
samuel.young@orionmed.com

Attachment: orionmed_business_justification.pdf (submitted by Orion)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Young <samuel.young@orionmed.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 180d tenant debug log retention + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Samuel — thanks for the clear ask and the justification doc. Looping in our security and compliance leads (Irene and Kimberly) to scope this quickly.

High level next steps I propose:
1) Security team to confirm whether a tenant-scoped retention variance is operationally supported (isolated metadata/TTL override) and list any compensating controls.
2) Compliance to provide CAIQ mapping / SIG excerpts applicable to log retention and a redacted SOC 2 attestation excerpt.
3) Mutual action plan (MAP) for contract amendment and change order language so procurement can review by Nov 5.

Irene/Kimberly — can you confirm what artifacts we can provide by EOD Oct 31 and any follow-up questions for Orion? I can coordinate the MAP and procurement packet.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Samuel Young <samuel.young@orionmed.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-30T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 180d tenant debug log retention + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Samuel / Karthik — thanks for the ping. A few clarifying points from Security & Compliance so we scope correctly:

1) Operational feasibility: Our serving runtime supports per-tenant TTL overrides for non-production debug snapshots and per-tenant indexed debug traces via a tenant metadata flag. That said, a customer-specific 180d retention is considered a deviation from the standard platform baseline and requires:
   - Narrow scope definition (what exact artifact types must be retained: e.g., index-only, full payload, traces vs ephemeral snapshots).
   - A documented justification tied to regulatory or legal requirement (you've attached this, which helps).
   - Compensating controls: restrict access via KMS-wrapped key, audit logging for any access to retained debug artifacts, and quarterly retention review.

2) Evidence we can provide immediately (attached):
   - redwood_soc2_report_Q2_2028.pdf (SOC 2 report excerpt — redacted sections removed for confidentiality)
   - sig_response_excerpt.txt (SIG items relevant to logging and deletion controls)
   - CAIQ mapping (we will produce caiq_mapping_orionmed.xlsx scoped to your questions)

3) Questions for Orion (short):
   - Which tenants/environments? (prod only, prod+staging?)
   - Exactly which artifact classes must be kept for 180d: 
     * session-level debug snapshots (full payload)
     * index/trace metadata only
     * KV cache dumps or ephemeral kernel dumps
   - Who will have access (roles or named admins)? We need principle-of-least-privilege mapping to set KMS policies.

4) Proposed timeline:
   - Oct 30 EOD: we deliver SOC 2 excerpt and SIG text (attached) + provisional CAIQ mapping stub.
   - Oct 31: complete CAIQ mapping and an internal runbook for how retention is implemented and audited.
   - Nov 2: draft change order language for the contract and an operations runbook to be included as an exhibit.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_report_Q2_2028.pdf; sig_response_excerpt.txt; provisional caiq_mapping_orionmed.xlsx (will be finalized Tue 10/31).

Access to evidence: We also have a secure evidence portal (limited-time links). For deals we typically deliver read-only artifacts via the portal referenced below. Please confirm who should receive portal access.

Evidence portal: https://evidence.redwood.com/portal/ORN-0893

Thanks — I will follow up with the CAIQ mapping this evening.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Samuel Young <samuel.young@orionmed.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orionmed.com
Date: 2028-11-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 180d tenant debug log retention + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Irene — appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers below to your short questions: 

- Scope: production tenant only (tenant id: ORN-PROD-12). Staging does not need the 180d retention.
- Artifact classes: index/trace metadata plus related session debug snapshots for any request that triggers a clinical-flagged event (we can provide a filter list). We do NOT require kernel dumps or full KV cache exports.
- Access: two named Orion roles (SecurityOps@orionmed.com and IR-Leads@orionmed.com); access should be time-bound and logged.

We reviewed the SOC 2 excerpt and SIG text you attached. Procurement is happy to receive the CAIQ mapping and the draft change order by Nov 2 so we can route the amendment for signature. I have uploaded our signed business justification and a procurement cover sheet.

Attachments: orionmed_business_justification.pdf (original), procurement_change_order_signed.pdf

Next steps per our side: please provide the CAIQ mapping (xlsx) and the operations runbook you mentioned. Also note — our legal team will want the change order to include explicit deletion and verification language (proof-of-delete workflow after 180d). Happy to accept a redlined exhibit.

Thank you,
Samuel Young
Head of IT Security — Orion Medical
samuel.young@orionmed.com
